verdict.rationale: Cactus is a lightweight on-device engine: it installs via brew and runs with `cactus run`, its models are small (Whistle is a single 16.9 MB CPU file, and the smallest models run on budget phones and Raspberry Pis), and a user called it the fastest offline LLM they had seen on their phone. None of this measures cold-start or model-load time, and a community critique notes that models download inline at runtime, which forces apps to block on a first-run progress bar. Missing for 10: documented or benchmarked cold-start/load latency, evidence about runtime binary size, and a pre-download/cache API to avoid first-run delays.
